metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for dynamic method patching and restoration in provider clients. It differs semantically from peer candidates (tool binding, observability initialization) and existing skills (D3 event listeners, Future state inspection). No existing skill covers the monkey-patching pattern for transparent event interception on provider methods. Peer candidates operate at different layers (tool instrumentation, environment setup) and do not overlap with method-level patching logic.
